observations: A green vintage-style sewing machine with a metal body and a handwheel on the right side.
The machine is mounted on a dark-colored table with a metal stand.
Photo 2 shows the full setup including a foot pedal with the brand name 'SINGER' visible on the metal grate.
The machine has a golden emblem with a lion and text that appears to say 'SINGER' on the front panel.
There is a small metal plate near the handwheel with some text, but it is not legible in the photos.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some wear and minor scratches.
The seller claims it is 'Original German manual sewing machine both electric and manual', but no German branding or model is visible.
The foot pedal is present, suggesting it may be electric or treadle-operated, but no power cord is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The brand 'SINGER' is visible on the foot pedal and front emblem, which is an American brand, not German. No German branding or model is visible in any photo.

The foot pedal is present, which may indicate electric or treadle operation, but no power cord or electrical components are visible. The handwheel suggests manual operation, but the electric capability cannot be confirmed from the photos.
This is a subjective claim and cannot be verified from photos alone. The machine appears functional and in reasonable condition, but suitability for home use depends on user needs and maintenance.
